rows.text: Read the third line of the commander carefully, because it is the entire deck: "triggered abilities you control can't cause you to sacrifice or exile creature tokens you control." Every temporary copy effect in Magic ends with a delayed trigger that sacrifices or exiles the token. The Master turns all of them off. Myriad tokens stay. Electroduplicate's copy stays. Delina's tokens stay. And because the legend rule does not apply to your tokens, you can copy legends as many times as you like.

rows.name: The Master, Multiplied
rows.text: myriad on a 4/3, no legend rule for your tokens, and no trigger of yours may sacrifice or exile them. Six mana, and it converts a dozen cards in the deck from "a copy until end of turn" into "a copy, permanently".

rows.name: Blade of Selves
rows.text: myriad on anything. In a four-player pod that is two permanent token copies of the equipped creature every single attack.

rows.name: Goldlust Triad
rows.text: myriad on a flier that makes Treasures on connection.

guide.title: Copy effects that stop being temporary

rows.text: All of these normally end with a delayed sacrifice or exile trigger. With The Master out, the tokens simply stay on the battlefield.

rows.name: Electroduplicate
rows.text: a permanent copy of any creature you control, twice with flashback.

rows.name: Molten Duplication
rows.text: a permanent artifact copy of a creature or artifact.

rows.name: Heat Shimmer
rows.text: a permanent copy of ANY creature, including theirs.

rows.name: Devastating Onslaught
rows.text: X permanent copies of your best creature. This is usually the game.

rows.name: Jaxis, the Troublemaker
rows.text: a permanent copy every turn for {R} and a discarded card.

rows.name: Determined Iteration
rows.text: populate every combat, and the copy stays.

rows.name: Delina, Wild Mage
rows.text: token copies on every attack, and the roll can chain — with The Master they all stay.

rows.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker
rows.text: the Kiki-Jiki back face copies a nonlegendary creature every turn, permanently.

rows.name: Foggy Swamp Visions
rows.text: copies of creature cards out of ANY graveyard, permanently.

rows.name: Gogo, Mysterious Mime
rows.text: becomes a copy of your best creature every combat, with haste and a pump.

rows.name: Cursed Mirror
rows.text: a hasty copy of the best creature on the board, and a mana rock afterwards.

rows.name: Impact Tremors
rows.text: one damage to each opponent per creature entering. A myriad attack in a four-player pod is two triggers.

rows.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
rows.text: TWO damage to each opponent per creature entering, on an indestructible body. This is the deck's primary kill — a Devastating Onslaught for four is sixteen damage to every opponent before combat.

rows.name: Enduring Courage
rows.text: every creature that enters gets +2/+0 and haste, so the copies attack immediately.

rows.name: Idol of Oblivion
rows.text: a card every turn you made a token, which is every turn.

rows.name: Grim Hireling
rows.text: two Treasures per combat damage step.

rows.name: Professional Face-Breaker
rows.text: a Treasure per combat step, convertible into impulse draws.

rows.name: Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor
rows.text: a card for every creature that connects with an opponent. On a myriad attack that is one per token.

rows.name: Karlach, Fury of Avernus
rows.text: untaps all attackers, gives first strike, and grants an additional combat phase. Every myriad creature triggers again — and with The Master, that is another permanent batch of tokens.

rows.name: Cover of Darkness
rows.text: name the type your board is and almost nothing can block.

rows.name: Dolmen Gate
rows.text: your attackers take no combat damage at all, so attacking with everything is free.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: haste and shroud for the commander.

rows.name: Deadly Rollick
rows.text: free with your commander out.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: free, and it redirects the removal aimed at The Master.

rows.name: Bolt Bend
rows.text: nearly free with a big creature out, same effect.

rows.name: Imp's Mischief
rows.text: the black version, and it can steal their tutor.

rows.name: Feed the Swarm
rows.text: the only clean enchantment answer in Rakdos.

rows.name: Chaos Warp
rows.text: the second one, and it covers planeswalkers.

rows.name: Blasphemous Act
rows.text: essentially free on a board full of tokens, and you rebuild faster than anyone.

rows.name: Plumb the Forbidden
rows.text: sacrifice your tokens in response to a wrath and draw a card for each. It turns a board wipe into a full refill.

rows.name: Animate Dead
rows.text: brings back the best creature in any graveyard, which is then copyable.

rows.name: Dark Ritual
rows.text: turn-one acceleration.

rows.name: Jeska's Will
rows.text: with a commander out, both halves — a huge mana burst and three impulse cards.

rows.name: Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer
rows.text: a Treasure and a stolen card on the first hit, and it is a fine myriad target.

rows.name: Black Market Connections
rows.text: three effects a turn.

rows.name: Night's Whisper
rows.text: two cards for two mana.

rows.name: Mind Stone
rows.text: ramp early, a card later.

rows.name: Rakdos Signet
rows.text: fixing.

rows.name: Fellwar Stone
rows.text: usually taps for what you need.

rows.name: Firebender Ascension
rows.text: builds counters off your attack triggers, then starts copying them outright.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep acceleration. The Master costs six and the deck is far weaker without him — Dark Ritual, Signets and Jeska's Will are what land him on turn four.
Cast the copy effects AFTER The Master, not before. The same Electroduplicate is a temporary body without him and a permanent second copy with him. If he is not out yet, hold them.

rows.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
rows.text: this is the win condition. Count the table's life before a big copy turn — two damage per token per opponent adds up faster than the combat step does.

rows.name: Karlach, Fury of Avernus
rows.text: with a myriad creature on the board, her extra combat is a second full batch of permanent tokens. Attack, make tokens, untap, attack again.
